name: DhanSafal Finserve Limited
about: DhanSafal Finserve Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides retail financial services in India. The company offers financing solutions to meet business short-term capital needs; micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) loans; and loan against property solutions for business expansion, investment, or debt consolidation. It serves individuals, small businesses, and MSMEs. The company was formerly known as Luharuka Media & Infra Limited and changed its name to DhanSafal Finserve Limited in May 2025. DhanSafal Finserve Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
